content_sections.heading: AP DSC Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The recruitment is being conducted through the Andhra Pradesh Teacher Recruitment Test (APTRT–2026), also known as DSC-2026. The department has published distinct notifications for regular teachers, special education posts and societies.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Notification 2026: Three Official Notifications
content_sections.text: Do not treat all 2,721 posts as one teacher category. The recruitment has three separate notifications with different managements, qualifications and selection provisions.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Vacancy 2026 Post-Wise
content_sections.text: Secondary Grade Teacher is the largest individual category with 1,205 regular posts. The table below also identifies special education and residential-school vacancies separately.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC 2026 District-Wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The 26-district breakup below covers 2,461 regular and special education posts . Society vacancies (260 posts) are counted separately, not added to any district in this table. Kurnool has 404 posts, followed by Prakasam (291) and YSR Kadapa (227).

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Societies Vacancies 2026
content_sections.text: These posts are under residential education societies, model schools and the Welfare of Differently Abled, Transgender and Senior Citizens Department. The vacancy distribution varies by society and cadre.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for AP DSC 2026? Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Educational qualifications are post-specific and governed by the relevant recruitment rules and Information Bulletin. Applicants should not assume that qualification for SGT also qualifies them for SA, TGT, PGT, Principal, PD, PET or Special Education posts. Check the appropriate bulletin for the required academic degree, professional teacher-training qualification, subject or medium, TET eligibility where applicable, and any special education recognition requirements. The notifications direct candidates to the Information Bulletin for the complete post-wise qualifications. Applicants must meet the prescribed qualifications by the applicable notification cutoff; check the relevant bulletin before paying the fee.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Age is calculated as on 1 July 2026 . The detailed notifications provide an ordinary upper limit of 44 years, with higher limits for specified reserved categories.

rows.age_limit: Relaxation as provided in the relevant recruitment notification

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee is ₹1,000 for each post . Candidates applying for more than one post should check the relevant application instructions and the total payable amount before submitting payment. The official payment window runs from 11 to 30 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Selection Process and Minimum Qualifying Marks
content_sections.text: The selection method depends on the post. The regular SA (except Physical Education) and SGT notifications specify aggregate TRT (80%) and qualifying TET (20%) marks. The societies notification specifies TRT (80%) and TET (20%) for TGT, while Principal, PGT, PD and PET qualifying marks are based on TRT (100%). Do not apply the same weightage mechanically to every post. These are minimum qualifying thresholds, not guaranteed selection cutoffs. The societies notification also provides an English Language Proficiency screening test for Principal, non-language PGT and non-language TGT candidates: 60/100 marks for OC, BC and EWS; 50/100 for SC, ST, PwBD and ex-servicemen. The notification excludes TGT Special Education (Special Schools) from this English screening test. The Special Education notification separately provides certain eligible service candidates with service weightage of 0.5 marks per completed year, up to 5 marks , subject to the stated conditions and overall maximum. Candidates must refer to that notification for eligible service categories and proof requirements. Also Check: AP DSC Syllabus 2026

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Syllabus 2026 and Exam Pattern
content_sections.text: The Government of Andhra Pradesh has released a detailed suggestive syllabus covering SGT, SGT Special Education, School Assistants, TGT, TGT Special Education, PGT, Principals and Physical Education posts. Candidates should prepare using the syllabus for their exact post and subject; the department states that the topics are indicative rather than exhaustive. The official syllabus also includes separate subject coverage for School Assistant languages, Mathematics, Physical Science, Biological Science and Social Studies; distinct TGT and PGT papers; English proficiency where applicable; Principals; PET; and SA-PE/PD. Open the official syllabus PDF rather than relying on a generic common syllabus.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for AP DSC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The applications will be available on the official recruitment website from 11 November 2026. The notification says that a detailed User Guide will be made available from that date; exact portal field names should be followed from that guide rather than assumed in advance. Visit the official portal at tet2dsc.apcfss.in . Read the correct detailed notification and Information Bulletin for the post. Check your qualifications, age, TET requirements and district or management eligibility. From 11 November, follow the registration and application steps shown in the official User Guide. Review all details carefully and pay the prescribed ₹1,000 fee per post. Complete the final submission by 30 November 2026 and retain the application confirmation for future reference.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Notification 2026 PDFs and Important Links
content_sections.text: The recruitment portal provides the three detailed notifications, Information Bulletins and syllabus. Use the portal to obtain the latest documents and any subsequent corrigendum.

faq.question: Q1. Is the AP DSC detailed notification 2026 released?
faq.answer: Yes. The Andhra Pradesh School Education Department issued three detailed DSC-2026 notifications on 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many posts are announced under AP DSC 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2,721 posts: 2,111 regular teachers, 350 special education posts and 260 posts in societies and other managements.

faq.question: Q3. When does AP DSC online registration start?
faq.answer: Online applications start on 11 November 2026 at tet2dsc.apcfss.in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the AP DSC 2026 application last date?
faq.answer: The deadline for online submission and fee payment is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the AP DSC application fee?
faq.answer: The official fee is ₹1,000 per post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the AP DSC 2026 age limit?
faq.answer: The ordinary age limit is 18–44 years as on 1 July 2026. The stated upper age limits extend to 49 years for SC/ST/BC/EWS and 54 years for PwBD candidates, subject to notification conditions.

faq.question: Q7. When will the AP DSC 2026 exam be held?
faq.answer: Examinations are scheduled from 20 December 2026 to 13 January 2027.

faq.question: Q8. When will AP DSC hall tickets be available?
faq.answer: The official schedule lists 14 December 2026 for hall ticket downloads.

faq.question: Q9. Which district has the most AP DSC vacancies?
faq.answer: Kurnool has 404 regular and special education posts combined, followed by Prakasam with 291.

faq.question: Q10. Is AP TET or CTET weightage applicable to all AP DSC posts?
faq.answer: No. TRT/TET weightage depends on the post. For example, the societies notification uses TRT/TET aggregate for TGT, but TRT marks for Principal, PGT, PD and PET. Read the applicable Information Bulletin for complete rules.
